main.hero: Producer of natural, reconstituted, pasteurized juices
main.rawMaterialsCard1: To make our juices we use our own fruit and berry concentrates, produced from carefully selected raw materials using modern processing and quality-control technologies
main.rawMaterialsCard2: Our own concentrate production lets us control every stage - from sourcing raw materials to the finished product - ensuring a consistent taste, natural aroma and high juice quality
main.rawMaterialsCard3: Production uses natural juice bases and prepared water, while gentle pasteurization helps preserve the natural properties of fruits and berries.
main.heroText: Juices, fruit and berry teas, and fruit smoothies—the vibrant flavor of carefully selected fruits and berries
main.feature4Text: A healthy drink for the whole family

productionSteps.title: Stages of making EVA juices
productionSteps.step1: Production uses quality fruit and berry concentrates and prepared water. Juice reconstitution
productionSteps.step2: The concentrate is blended with water in the right proportions to restore the juice's natural taste and texture. Filtering and preparation
productionSteps.step3: The juice is cleared and quality-checked to achieve a stable consistency and clarity. Pasteurization
productionSteps.step4: The product undergoes gentle heat treatment, which helps preserve its taste, aroma and safety. Filling and packaging
productionSteps.step5: The finished juice or tea is filled into clean containers under sterile conditions, after which the bottles and packs are sealed airtight. Filling and packaging
productionSteps.step6: Every batch is checked against quality standards before being shipped to customers. Storage and delivery
productionSteps.step7: Finished products are stored under proper conditions and delivered to partners and customers

aboutUs.intro: EVA 2020 LLC is a Ukrainian producer of juices and fruit drinks made from natural ingredients.
aboutUs.historyText: For more than five years we've been making quality products for Ukrainian consumers, combining modern production technology, natural ingredients and strict quality control at every stage.
aboutUs.rawMaterialText: Our range includes juices and concentrated teas made from carefully selected raw materials. We strive for every product to have a rich, natural taste, retain the beneficial properties of fruit, and meet the highest safety standards.
aboutUs.trustText: Our mission is to produce natural, high-quality drinks that give Ukrainian families goodness, freshness and the true taste of fruit every day. We keep improving production, expanding our range and introducing modern solutions to meet the needs of the Ukrainian market and offer consumers products they can trust.
aboutUs.allUkraineText: Our company works with retail chains, distributors and partners across Ukraine, ensuring steady supply and consistently high product quality.
aboutUs.footballText: EVA 2020 LLC is a general partner of children's football and actively supports the development of young athletes, promoting a healthy lifestyle and sporting values among children.
aboutUs.tirasText: The company is a general partner of the Tiras children's football school and the Tiras football center in the city of Horodok. We help create modern conditions for training, talent development and sporting events, so every child has the chance to play football, improve their skills and move confidently toward their sporting goals.
aboutUs.socialText: For us, social responsibility means more than making quality products - it's also an investment in Ukraine's future. We believe that supporting children's sport builds a healthy, strong and purposeful generation. EVA 2020 LLC will continue to support initiatives that develop children's football, because today's young players are tomorrow's champions of Ukraine.
aboutUs.сhurchTitle: Rebuilding the church in the village of Lepesivka
aboutUs.сhurchText: EVA joined the effort to rebuild the church in the village of Lepesivka, supporting a project that matters greatly to the local community. As part of the initiative, the company took part in the restoration work and helped equip the church with everything it needs to function fully.
aboutUs.сhurchText1: For EVA, social responsibility means more than supporting individual initiatives - it's a real contribution to community development, to preserving spiritual and cultural values, and to creating places that matter to people. We believe that supporting such projects helps bring communities together, preserve traditions, and build a solid foundation for the future.
aboutUs.volonterText: EVA consistently supports Ukrainian servicemen and the Armed Forces of Ukraine, taking part in charitable initiatives and helping meet the pressing needs of our defenders.
aboutUs.volonterText1: One important area of support is purchasing and handing over vehicles to military units. Transport is critically important at the front: it's needed for the rapid movement of servicemen, carrying out combat tasks, transporting necessary equipment, and ensuring the mobility of units. That's why EVA has repeatedly helped supply the military with the vehicles they need.
aboutUs.volonterText2: Besides handing over vehicles, the company supports fundraisers and charitable projects, helps cover the military's essential needs, and takes part in initiatives supporting the Armed Forces of Ukraine. For EVA, helping Ukrainian defenders isn't a one-off gesture but an ongoing focus of our social responsibility. We understand how important it is today for business and society to join forces for a common goal.
aboutUs.volonterText3: We continue to support our military, to help wherever it's needed most, and to contribute to strengthening Ukraine's defense capability. Together, we stand behind those who defend our country every day. Together - for Ukraine and for Victory.

partners.title: Reliable partners — a strong country
partners.text: We're grateful to our partners for their trust and cooperation. Together we bring Ukrainians quality natural juices.

concentrates.paragraph1: Our range includes juices, concentrated fruit-and-berry teas and other drinks made from carefully selected raw materials. We pay special attention to the quality of our fruits and berries to preserve their natural taste, aroma and properties, and to ensure consistently high quality of the finished product.
concentrates.paragraph2: A separate line of our business is producing concentrated fruit and berry juices, which are also made from select raw materials and can be used to make beverages and food products.
concentrates.paragraph3: Learn more about our concentrated juices and full range on our dedicated website.
